brief: 6 viral content formats every creator should steal.

slots.title: Steal these viral formats
slots.ctaText: Save these for your next post

slots.title: The Carousel Hook
slots.body: Carousels boost saves and shares because they pack multiple value bombs into one swipeable post. Start with a bold cover that stops the scroll instantly.

slots.title: Green Screen Takes
slots.body: React to trending clips or tweets using the green screen filter. It’s the fastest way to share hot takes without a fancy setup.

slots.title: Day In The Life
slots.body: Show the messy reality behind your polished brand. People crave relatable moments, so film your morning coffee or chaotic inbox.

slots.title: POV Story Hooks
slots.body: Drop viewers straight into the action with a strong point-of-view opener. It feels personal and triggers that irresistible curiosity gap.

slots.title: Hot Take Lists
slots.body: Combine a numbered list with a spicy opinion for instant engagement. Lists promise value, but your bold spin keeps them watching.

slots.title: Storytime Confessions
slots.body: Open with a wild hook like 'I messed up huge today,' then unpack the lesson. Drama plus wisdom equals gold.

slots.headline: Steal These Formats Today
slots.body: Pick one format and post it today. Your next viral hit is one swipe away.
